Class Room

java.lang.Object
fr.uge.map.Room
public class Room extends Object
Represents a room in a dungeon floor. A room can contain enemies, a merchant, a healer, treasure, or a door. It can also be part of a grid and keep track of its neighbors.

  • Method Details

    • getBattleView

      public BattleView getBattleView(Hero hero, Dungeon dungeon, ImageLoader imagesHero, ImageLoader imagesEnemies, ImageLoader imagesItems, ImageLoader imagesStatus)
      Returns the BattleView for this room. If the room has no enemies, returns null. If the BattleView or FightGraphics is not yet created, they are initialized here. If the room has already been visited, shows a message indicating that enemies were defeated.
      Parameters:
      hero - The hero who will fight in this room
      dungeon - The dungeon containing this room
      imagesHero - Images for the hero
      imagesEnemies - Images for the enemies
      imagesItems - Images for items
      imagesStatus - Images for status indicators
      Returns:
      The BattleView of this room, or null if no enemies are present

    • getTreasureView

      public TreasureView getTreasureView(Hero hero, Dungeon dungeon, ImageLoader images, ImageLoader imagesItems)
      Returns the TreasureView for this room. If it hasn't been created yet, it will be initialized here.
      Parameters:
      hero - The hero who will collect the loot
      dungeon - The dungeon containing this room
      images - Images for the room map
      imagesItems - Images for the items
      Returns:
      The TreasureView for this room

    • getHealerView

      public HealerView getHealerView(Hero hero, Dungeon dungeon, ImageLoader imagesMap, ImageLoader imagesServices, ImageLoader imagesItems)
      Returns the HealerView for this room. If the room does not have a healer, returns null. If it hasn't been created yet, it will be initialized here.
      Parameters:
      hero - The hero to heal
      dungeon - The dungeon containing this room
      imagesMap - Images for the room map
      imagesServices - Images for service icons
      imagesItems - Images for items
      Returns:
      The HealerView for this room, or null if no healer is present

    • getMerchantView

      public MerchantView getMerchantView(Hero hero, Dungeon dungeon, ImageLoader imagesHero, ImageLoader imagesServices, ImageLoader imagesItems)
      Returns the MerchantView for this room. If the room does not have a merchant, returns null. If it hasn't been created yet, it will be initialized here.
      Parameters:
      hero - The hero who can buy or sell items
      dungeon - The dungeon containing this room
      imagesHero - Images for the hero
      imagesServices - Images for service icons
      imagesItems - Images for items
      Returns:
      The MerchantView for this room, or null if no merchant is present
